meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法问成一份可照做的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望在动手写代码前先得到一个清晰、完整、可执行的实施步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague ideas into an actionable development plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, executable plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 用户明确要求做计划时，先宣告进入规划模式；随后只读探索代码库、不写产品代码，探索后少问尖锐问题；获批后才在 .omo/ 下生成一份决策完备的计划，让执行者无需再访谈即可开工。
howto.when: 只有用户主动要求做工作计划时才触发，例如说出 `ulw-plan`、`make a plan`、“先做计划再写代码”等；不会因普通的 `ulw` 运行或智能体自行路由而激活。

say.text: ulw-plan：先给登录接口做一个实施计划
say.note: 进入规划模式，只读探索后等批准，再写计划文件。

say.text: 先规划再改：把 auth 重构拆成可执行步骤
say.note: 启动规划流程，需要你明确批准后才产出计划。

howto.what_en: On explicit user request for planning, Claude enters plan mode, explores read-only without editing code, asks only necessary questions, and after approval writes a decision-complete plan file under .omo/ so an executor needs zero extra interviews.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when the user explicitly requests planning, e.g. saying ulw-plan, 'make a plan', or asking for a plan before coding; never self-activates on ordinary runs.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: make an implementation plan for the login endpoint first
say_en.note: Enters plan mode, explores read-only, waits for approval, then writes the plan.

say_en.text: Plan before coding: break the auth refactor into executable steps
say_en.note: Starts the planning flow; the plan is written only after explicit approval.
